invariants.rationale: The method uses data.collectAsList(), so data must not be null to avoid a NullPointerException.
seqOp::apply is passed as a method reference; seqOp must not be null.
combOp::apply is used in the reduction; combOp must not be null.
collectAsList() must not return null since it will be streamed and reduced.
zeroValue is used as the initial value in reduce; must not be null for correct reduction.
